long_biography.plain_text:
Olivo grew up in Fuente Álamo, Murcia, and entered working life early. Earthmoving and civil-construction work gave him experience in land and large projects before he moved into property on his own account. In the 1990s he acquired a site near Marbella, where La Cañada opened in 1997 and established his direction in retail real estate.

General de Galerías Comerciales extended that approach across Andalusia, Catalonia, the Canary Islands and Murcia. Its model joins development, ownership and management rather than ending with construction. Near-total share ownership keeps strategic control with Olivo, while his combined chairmanship and chief-executive role makes him an active operator rather than a passive landlord. Financial investments broadened his holdings, but the shopping-centre platform remains the durable foundation of his fortune.
